prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide opening-cover illustration for an original browser incremental game. Lighting/mood: storm-dark but hopeful, salt-weathered, determined. Color palette: ivory paper, blue-black ink, rust red, brass ochre. Materials/textures: paper grain, scratched brass, ink crosshatching, rough coast. Constraints: original fictional location, no people, no letters or numbers, no text, no watermark, no logo, no UI. Avoid: photorealism, gradients, neon, fantasy castle, brand symbols, ornate frames, copyrighted characters or artist imitation.
